quote_text: Concentration is a fine antidote to anxiety.

source: Nicklaus, Jack. 'My Story' (1997)

quote_text: The longer you play, the better chance the better player has of winning.
context: On why sustained composure matters more than single-shot brilliance in stroke play

quote_text: No matter how good you get you can always get better, and that's the exciting part.

quote_text: Competitive golf is played mainly on a five-and-a-half-inch course — the space between your ears.

quote_text: The biggest thing is to have a mindset and a belief that you can win every tournament going in.
